feature.name: Infinite tapped creature tokens with haste

variants.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to make a token copy of Vizier of Tumbling Sands with haste.
Tap the Vizier of Tumbling Sands token to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat for infinite ETB and tapped creature tokens with haste.

Cast Demonic Consultation by paying {B}, naming Thassa's Oracle and thus exiling your library due to you not having a card named Thassa's Oracle in your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

variants.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 4.
variants.description:
Cast Doomsday Excruciator by paying six {B}.
When Doomsday Excruciator enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each player to exile all but the bottom six cards of their library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
When Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to win the game.

Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Little Bear with haste.
When the Little Bear token enters, it triggers, untapping Kiki-Jiki
Repeat.

template.name: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

variants.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mirror Image that has haste. Choose to have Mirror Image enter as a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Put the oldest Kiki-Jiki into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat step 1 using the Mirror Image token instead.
variants.notes: The chosen anthem effect must increase Mirror Image's toughness.

feature.name: Infinite charge counters on a permanent

variants.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Phantom Steed.
When the Phantom Steed token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Phantom Steed token.
When the Phantom Steed token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

Activate Black Lotus, sacrificing it to add {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Auriok Salvager, returning Black Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Black Lotus.
Repeat.

Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
Leveler enters the battlefield, triggering itself, exiling your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, triggering itself, causing you to win the game.

variants.notablePrerequisites:
Urban Daggertooth has at least one +1/+1 counter.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters.
variants.description:
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to Urban Daggertooth.
Urban Daggertooth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and Walking Ballista.
Repeat.

Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Teardrop Kami with haste.
Activate the Teardrop Kami token by sacrificing it, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

variants.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause Shorikai to become a creature this turn.
variants.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
variants.description:
Cause Shorikai to become a creature.
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Shorikai by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards, discard a card, and create a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
When the Pilot enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Blasphemous Act by paying at most {8}{R}, dealing 13 damage to each creature.
Repercussion triggers for each creature dealt damage this way.
Resolve the first Repercussion trigger, dealing 13 damage to an opponent.
Repeat step 3 for each Repercussion trigger, ensuring to resolve all triggers that would damage your opponent(s) first.
variants.notes: This combo will also deal damage to you equal to 13 times the number of creatures you control. It is recommended that your life total is above this number to ensure you don't lose the game from the damage if your opponents will not take lethal damage from this combo.
